answer_1.quote: We consider several text generation tasks, including text summarization (TS), question-answering (QA) with long free-form answers, QA based on reading comprehension, QA with short free-form answers, and multiple-choice QA.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates generated responses in tasks such as summarization and question answering, where models produce free-form or multiple-choice answers.

answer_2.quote: Following previous work, we use ROUGE-L, Accuracy, and AlignScore as text generation quality metrics.
